verdict.rationale: PostHog's feature-flag docs state that you can wrap a change in a flag, roll it out to a percentage of users (e.g. 1%) and turn it off without redeploying. They also say you can roll out by person property, cohort or group, which covers all three targeting dimensions in the story. The Slack agent example of rolling a flag out to users with an @example.com email adds a concrete property-targeting case. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of flag targeting, in-depth docs on how targeting conditions are combined and configured beyond brief overview statements.
